text: What do you suppose is the use of child without any meaning? Even a joke should have some meaning—and a child’s more important than a joke, I hope. You couldn’t deny that, even if you tried with both hands.” “I don’t deny things with my hands,” Alice objected. “Nobody said you did,” said the Red Queen. “I said you couldn’t if you tried.” “She’s in that state of mind,” said the White Queen, “that she wants to deny something—only she doesn’t know what to deny!” “A nasty, vicious temper,” the Red Queen remarked; and then there was an uncomfortable silence for a minute or two.
